snapshot.selection: original posted OR first detected OR edited in the window
snapshot.interpretation: Four deadlines do not explain all 55 unresolved jobs. Other unresolved conclusions require an independent intent and omission review; they are not all missed recommendations.

proof_of_avoidable_overtaking.effect: The hot expert's allocation was full while two of the four global worker slots were unused. Newer messages overtook a waiting message under posted_at DESC. The 60-second aging guard could not help a 20-second budget.

capacity_evidence.limits: Intervals end at conclusion or deadline trace, so they exclude the bounded post-result session cleanup. This is a measured scheduling cause, not proof that raising model concurrency would be safe.

deadline_examples.interpretation: Fast admission, slow model work before the first search batch; no completed record evidence.
Expert allocation and overtaking consumed about six seconds before model work. Both bound market groups had already been read before the deadline; source accuracy still requires separate review.
No queue bottleneck. Model work between search and market stages consumed the budget. This is a later revision of an older posted message, not a 5418-second collector delivery claim.
Complete candidate pagination and unique resolution consumed multiple model turns; unique resolution occurred just before the cutoff, with no record evidence.

remote_cleanup_and_model_parameters.caveat: No cleanup warnings and no 429 in retained logs do not prove every canonical remote run stopped. No real model probe or upstream parameter/configuration change was performed.

change.scope: worker _claim_from_lane waiting order only, plus dedicated isolated tests
change.known_detection_order: earliest detected_at first, then job.created_at FIFO for equal detection times
change.legacy_compatibility: Keep the original 60-second aging priority and NULL-detection newest-posted ordering. NULL remains unknown and is never replaced with an invented detection time.
change.goal: Eliminate later-arrival overtaking within a fair source/expert pair without increasing simultaneous model or database demand.
change.not_a_claim: EDF ordering alone cannot guarantee every recommendation is identified within 20 seconds, or that every expired message was recordable.

measurement_limits: A trace created_at is a PostgreSQL transaction timestamp, not an observed COMMIT acknowledgment. Concurrent trace order can differ from numeric timestamps.
Job creation after message persistence approximates media-ready admission but is not a separately recorded media completion clock.
Posted-to-detected age includes edited and recovered old messages. It must not be presented as pure Telegram transport delay.
Successful fast conclusions are selected survivors of the deadline policy; deadline failures are not successes in the 20-second recognition metric.
Combined MCP call arguments are not all present in child API trace parameters. Their absence cannot prove the model failed to use an existing combined tool.
